title: Perfect size counter protector/cutting board
text:
Perfect size counter protector/cutting board. This plastic counter protector replaces one I've had for 25 years and is a much better quality. Although it is designed to protect the counter, I use it as a cutting board as well. I always place doubled over wax paper on the board before cutting, so as not to cut into the plastic and get plastic bits into my food. Parchment paper would probably be a better choice, so I'll have to try that next time. Very pleased with this purchase. Expensive, but worth the investment.

Update on product: Had to return this counter protector because of very sharp corners It was perfect in all respects except for this.

product_metadata.title: Acrylic Plastic Products Counter Protector with Lip, 15-Inch by 15-Inch
features: Pebbled cutting surface won't show knife marks.
Won't retain food odors, scratch, chip, or warp.
Boards feature a counter lip, and style #10241 has angled up edges on two sides as well.
description: This 15" x 14 " Acrylic Cutting Board with Lip features a pebbled cutting surface that won't show knife marks, and non slip feet to hold boards firmly in place. The boards won't retain food odors, scratch, chip, or warp. Boards feature a counter lip that measures 1". Note: These cutting boards are NOT heat resistant. We do not advise placing hot pots, or pans, on the surface. . Made in America
